title: Cascade Vision Plans: Materials Benefits and Frequency Table
content:
Which eyewear a Vision Plans tier pays toward, and how often, is fixed per plan in this table. A plan without a lens, frame or contact-lens benefit leaves that eyewear to be bought at the plan's materials discount only.

| | Exam Plus | Essential 100 | Select 130 | Select 150 | Choice 175 | Premier 200 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spectacle-lens benefit | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Frame benefit | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Contact-lens benefit | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| One pair of spectacle lenses per | not covered (0) | 12 months | 12 months | 12 months | 12 months | 12 months |
| Patient under 19: one pair of lenses per | not covered (0) | 12 months | 12 months | 12 months | 6 months | 6 months |
| One frame per | not covered (0) | 24 months | 24 months | 24 months | 12 months | 12 months |
| One contact-lens benefit per | not covered (0) | 12 months | 12 months | 12 months | 12 months | 12 months |
| Frequency basis | from last service | from last service | from last service | by benefit year | by benefit year | by benefit year |
| Contacts in lieu of glasses | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Child benefits below age (years) | 19 | 19 | 19 | 19 | 19 | 19 |

**Terms used in the table**

- *Spectacle-lens benefit*, *frame benefit*, *contact-lens benefit*: "No" means the plan has no such benefit; for lenses, the lenses are then bought at the materials discount only.
- *Frequency months*: one service of that kind per the stated number of months; a figure of 0 means that kind of eyewear is not covered.
- *Child lens frequency*: for a patient under 19 on the date of service, one pair of spectacle lenses per the stated number of months.
- *Frequency basis — from last service*: a service becomes available again the stated months after the last paid date of service of the same kind.
- *Frequency basis — by benefit year*: 12 months means once per benefit period, and 24 months once per two consecutive benefit periods counted from the period of the last paid service.
- *Contacts in lieu of glasses — Yes*: an elective contact-lens benefit is used instead of both the lens and the frame benefit for the same frequency period.
- *Child benefits below age*: the age in years below which a patient receives child benefits (the child lens frequency and child polycarbonate).

**Comparing tiers**

Cascade Vision Exam Plus is the one plan with no materials benefit at all. Cascade Vision Essential 100, Select 130 and Select 150 renew the frame every 24 months; Choice 175 and Premier 200 renew it every 12 months and renew children's lenses every 6 months. Essential 100 and Select 130 count frequencies from the last service; Select 150, Choice 175 and Premier 200 count them by benefit year.
